sfx_review.label: pop
sfx_review.note: Short broadband transient right as the dot appears from nothing; shape reads as a pop rather than a reverse swoosh.

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: At 0.80 s, after this event and at the spectrogram edge; nothing visible to tie it to here.

pattern.description: Cold open on a flat green gradient: a single dark dot pops in from zero scale just above centre, growing quickly and drifting up slightly before settling, synced to a soft pop.
pattern.why_premium: A single primitive on an empty brand-colour field gives a calm, confident first frame and a focal point that later shapes can build from, with the sound landing exactly on the appearance.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.dot', {scale: 0, y: 12}, {scale: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out'}) starting on frame 1; trigger the pop SFX at the same time.
build_hint.remotion: const s = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 180}}); scale = s, translateY = interpolate(s, [0, 1], [12, 0]); no visible overshoot.

notes: The dot may be the first element of a Zendesk logo build (logo_resolve) in later events; cannot tell from this event alone, so 'other' is used. Energy decays smoothly with no rebound, so modelled as ease-out without overshoot.
